info.title: SMS Code Business OS export
info.description: Read-only GET API implemented by landing. Response bodies conform to business-os.contract.v1 schema 1.0.0. This file does not replace the pinned C0 schemas. Analytics reports stay unsupported until a provider is configured and a stored import exists. There is no deployed base URL.

businessOsHmac.name: X-BOS-Signature
businessOsHmac.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the C0 canonical string. Also send X-BOS-Key-Id, X-BOS-Timestamp, and X-BOS-Nonce. GET signs an empty body.
